subject: Security onboarding & incident notification timelines — next steps
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya@signalhealth.com>, Tom Reeves <tom.reeves@signalhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security onboarding & incident notification timelines — next steps

Hi Maya / Tom,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — appreciate the time. Quick recap and asks so we can move the procurement/security review forward: 

- SOC 2 status: you mentioned an auditor engagement in Q3. Can you confirm whether you have a final SOC 2 Type II report or an interim letter we can share with our security team?
- Data protection: need a short note on GDPR/HIPAA applicability and whether you are processing PHI for the use case we discussed.
- Vendor security questionnaire: attached is our intake spreadsheet (Column A = question). Can you start filling the tab labelled "Signal responses"? If easier, send a completed PDF.
- Incident response & breach notification: we need an illustrative timeline for detection -> containment -> notification to customers/regulators (including any contractual SLAs you commit to). Please include RTO/RPO goals for your BCP/DR plan.

Next steps proposed:
1) You send SOC 2 artefact + initial answers to the questionnaire by EOD Wednesday (10/07).
2) We will route docs to our security reviewer (Ben) and schedule a 30-min follow-up to close gaps.

I attached our questionnaire template and a short checklist for the IR evidence we typically request. If the timeline above is tight, let me know what works and we can extend by a few days.

Thanks — Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Maya Patel <maya@signalhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reeves <tom.reeves@signalhealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security onboarding & incident notification timelines — next steps

Karthik — thanks for the clear summary. Quick answers and next steps from Signal: 

- SOC 2: we have a SOC 2 Type II report from June 2026; I attached the executive letter (redacted).
- GDPR/HIPAA: our product is configurable; for the pilot you described we will be handling limited PHI. We process data under our BAAs and our privacy team applies standard minimization.
- Questionnaire: attaching a first-pass "Signal_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx" with several cells filled; we'll update remaining items by Wednesday.
- IR timeline & BCP: attached a short BCP overview and a high-level incident-notification timeline — includes our customer notification target of 72 hours post-confirmation, and internal escalation windows. We can provide more granular logs/evidence on request.

One ask: can Ben share a prioritized list of the IR/DR evidence you most need for procurement vs. what can be provided later during contract stage?

I'll follow up with Tom to fill the remaining questionnaire rows.

Best,
Maya

Attachments: Signal_SOC2_TypeII_letter.pdf, Signal_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx, BCP_DR_Overview.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security onboarding & incident notification timelines — next steps

Karthik / Laura — I pulled the initial ask into our intake checklist. Suggested priority for Signal:

1) Provide SOC 2 artefact (already done — thanks). Security can accept redacted reports for preliminary review.
2) Incident response timeline & sample evidence (high priority): we need a sample incident timeline that shows detection timestamp, containment action, and root-cause note; if Signal can provide anonymized (or redacted) examples of post-incident logs or a tabletop report, that would accelerate procurement.
3) BCP/DR RTO & RPO targets + a short runbook excerpt showing recovery steps (page or two).
4) Completed questionnaire for all high-risk controls. Lower-risk items can be tracked during contracting.

I drafted a short email that we can send to their security contact to clarify scope. Also created a shared Drive folder for the ticket: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0BxyzSignal/Onboarding (please add your notes).

If Signal can hit Wednesday EOD for items 1–3, we can aim to finish the security review by Oct 14 and present a consolidated risk summary to Legal.

Ben
--
Ben Carter
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com

From: Tom Reeves <tom.reeves@signalhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Maya Patel <maya@signalhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 07 Oct 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security onboarding & incident notification timelines — next steps

Karthik / Ben / Laura — following up after Maya's submission. A few clarifications from our side: 

- The SOC 2 letter we sent is the finalized Type II report. We can arrange a full report under an NDA if needed.
- For IR evidence, we can provide an anonymized tabletop summary and an example containment log showing timestamps (we redact customer identifiers). Will attach the tabletop doc by COB tomorrow.
- Our standard customer notification SLA is 72 hours after incident confirmation; for enterprise contracts we can negotiate faster windows and include escalation contacts.
- BCP RTO/RPO: current targets are RTO = 4 hours for core services, RPO = 1 hour for critical DBs. We will include the runbook excerpt in the package.

I'll upload the promised artifacts to the Drive folder and reply here when complete. Thanks for the prioritization — helps us focus what to redact.

Tom
